nodes.name: app.component.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests verifying that the root AppComponent creates successfully and renders its router-outlet.

nodes.name: app.component.ts
nodes.summary: Root standalone component of the microfrontend; the element single-spa mounts in the shell (or index.html mounts in standalone mode), hosting only the domain's router-outlet.

nodes.name: auth.interceptor.ts
nodes.summary: Functional HTTP interceptor that attaches the OAuth2 Bearer token (read from localStorage, set by the shell's OAuth flow) to requests targeting the institutional WSO2-gated APIs.
nodes.languageNotes: Falls back to a DEV_TOKEN constant for local testing when no token is found in localStorage; that fallback and dev-token.ts are meant to be deleted before production.

nodes.name: dev-token.ts
nodes.summary: Local-testing-only constant holding a manually pasted access token so the interceptor can authenticate without running the shell's OAuth flow; must be deleted before production.

nodes.name: environment.ts
nodes.summary: Production environment configuration defining the institutional API base URLs (administrativa, novedades mid/crud, core amazon) and the OAuth2/OIDC endpoint and client settings used for authentication.

nodes.name: main.single-spa.ts
nodes.summary: Single-spa entry point wiring Angular lifecycle functions (bootstrap/mount/unmount) for the microfrontend; bootstraps AppComponent under the /novedades base href when hosted by the shell, or auto-bootstraps when run standalone.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses single-spa-angular's singleSpaAngular() to produce the standard single-spa lifecycle exports, and only auto-bootstraps when the standalone host element exists in the DOM (absent when hosted by the shell).

nodes.name: AppComponent
nodes.summary: Root component class for the microfrontend; empty body, purely a shell wrapping the standalone RouterOutlet template.

nodes.name: authInterceptor
nodes.summary: Checks whether the outgoing request targets a known institutional API, then attaches a Bearer token read from localStorage (or DEV_TOKEN as a local fallback) to the request headers.
